Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: Interactive PvP combat frames, reactive counter-CC, LB cues, and survival helpers.
Description: A local PvP HUD with fixed Self/S1-S5 combat frames, optional exact row targeting and mouseover, calibrated LB gauges, direct ally LB damage, pressure and CC cues, fail-closed reactive counter-CC, survival and job helpers, low-MP Focus, assists, team communication, and target highlights.
Changelog: Makes held WHM Miracle and BRD Silent Nocturne react once for the selected exact post-Purify or post-Guard protection-end episode without a minimum team-pressure gate; a later distinct release epoch can trigger on the same hold. Simultaneous releases produce exactly one winner ranked by known-first fresh team pressure, HP ratio, then known-first trusted MP ratio, and losers never become fallback attempts. Distinct S1-S5 post-Purify states, native 10/20-yalm reachability, higher-priority Purify/Smart Recuperate, direct targeting, and no-retry safeguards remain.
